summary: A short biographical note on jazz musician Charles Mingus, covering his birthplace in Nogales, Arizona, his father's military career, his upbringing in Los Angeles's Watts area, and his mixed ancestry. It describes his maternal grandparents and the multiethnic background of his family line.
one_line: Brief biographical sketch of jazz figure Charles Mingus, covering his birth in Nogales, Arizona, Watts upbringing, and mixed ancestry.
key_facts: Charles Mingus was born in Nogales, Arizona.
Charles Mingus's father, Charles Mingus Sr., was a sergeant in the U.S. Army.
Charles Mingus was largely raised in the Watts area of Los Angeles.
Charles Mingus's maternal grandfather was a Chinese British subject from Hong Kong.
Charles Mingus's maternal grandmother was an African-American from the southern United States.
Charles Mingus was the third great-grandson of the family's founding patriarch.
The family's founding patriarch was, by most accounts, a German immigrant.
Charles Mingus's ancestors included German American, African American, and Native American people.
